name: Holiness Of God
overview: The holiness of God is a defining attribute revealed throughout Scripture, emphasizing His unique and glorious nature, distinct from all other beings (Exodus 15:11). God commands His people to reflect His holiness, as He is holy Himself (Leviticus 19:2), calling them to live in purity and reverence before Him. The beauty and majesty of God's holiness inspire worship and awe across the earth (Psalms 96:9; Isaiah 6:3), while His eternal and lofty presence dwells with those who are humble and contrite in spirit (Isaiah 57:15). Through Christ, believers are chosen to be holy and blameless, set apart in love before God (Ephesians 1:4).
